subject: Dashboard down for our whole team
body: Our production dashboard has been down since 7am — all users get a 500 error and cannot access any reports. This is urgent, we have a board meeting at noon. Please fix ASAP.

subject: Charged twice for my subscription
body: Hi, I was charged twice this month for the Pro plan — two payments of $49.00 on my card for order #ORD-58213. Can you refund the duplicate charge? Thanks.

subject: Package still not arrived!!!
body: This is unacceptable. My order ORD-77120 was supposed to arrive last Friday and the tracking hasn't updated in 6 days. I've contacted you twice already. Where is my package?

subject: Locked out after 2FA reset
body: I got a new phone and now I can't log in because the 2FA code doesn't work. My account is locked. How can I sign in again?

subject: Feature idea: Slack integration
body: Love the product! It would be great if you could add a Slack integration so our team gets notified when a report is ready. Is this on the roadmap?

subject: iOS app crashes on export
body: The iOS app crashes every time I try to export a report to PDF. Started after the latest update. Still happening after reinstalling — a bit frustrating.

subject: Invoice for September
body: Could you send me the invoice for September for the Team plan? Our finance department needs it with our VAT number on it.

subject: Quick question
body: Hey, do you guys have an office in Austin? I might be in town next month.
